title: An innovation coach on the book Eric didn't write — 'I respect it'
summary: Sillies is an innovation coach and product strategist. He wrote the comment on a repost of Eric's LinkedIn post about who is accountable when AI-generated code fails.
blockquote:
He easily could have written "Lean Startup 2.0: How AI is Turning Everyone into the Next Silicon Valley Tech Bro" Instead, he wrote "Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad and How Great Companies Stay Great"

I respect it.
